g.text: Token exchange: purchaser reaches the hub with a node-signed assertion (no shared secret)
verify argon2id hash; store SHA-256 of new token
header {alg: Ed25519, typ: assertion+jwt, kid: ksp-2026-09}
claims {iss: ten_ksp, sub: sub_7QF2..., aud: sanovio-hub,
scope: purchaser, iat, exp: iat+300, jti}
header typ = assertion+jwt and alg = Ed25519
key by kid (tenant = iss, not revoked,
verify signature, aud, exp - iat <= 300 s,
iat not in the future (60 s skew)
[any check fails, jti already used, tenant inactive, principal blocked]
Using and renewing the hub token
token hash -> principal, tenant; kid not revoked
No refresh tokens: the client simply asks the node for a new assertion.
Revoking kid ksp-2026-09 at the hub rejects new assertions and every hub token issued from it.
